259:t_1:83.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「So they were fighting what we call $$バアル$$.」

259:t_1:84.en:
$$葵$$
「$$ミケーネ$$'s $$ハーデス$$ pompously called it a war between gods and demons.」

259:t_1:85.en:
$$タケル$$
「If $$サイデリアル$$ really wants Earth's $$次元力|lc$$ to fight $$バアル$$...」

259:t_1:86.en:
$$タケル$$
「If they'd asked us to cooperate as equals, that war might never have happened.」

259:t_1:87.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You're quite a romantic, thinking that way about invaders.」

259:t_1:88.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But it's wonderful to build friendships across the stars.」

259:t_1:89.en:
$$タケル$$
「Maybe I can think that way because I'm not an Earthling.」

259:t_1:90.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Where you were born doesn't matter... I think that's the power of your kindness, $$マーズ$$.」

259:t_1:92.en:
$$チコ$$
「Yes, yes, we've had our fill of your sweet talk.」

259:t_1:93.en:
$$朔哉$$
「It always ends up going this way, and I'm left out in the cold.」

259:t_1:94.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Don't be jealous! Cheer up, $$朔哉$$!」

259:t_1:95.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Thanks. Your cheerfulness really saves me, $$ノノ$$.」

259:t_1:96.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「No, $$朔哉$$. $$ラルク$$ won't stand for you making a move on $$ノノ$$.」

259:t_1:97.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I-it's none of my business... if $$ノノ$$ agrees.」

259:t_1:98.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis, how could you! You're offering $$ノノ$$ up to $$朔哉$$ as a sacrifice!」

259:t_1:99.en:
$$朔哉$$
「What the hell do you mean, a sacrifice!?」

259:t_1:100.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Don't you know? It's when circumstances force you to marry someone you don't even love.」

259:t_1:101.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That's not what I was asking!」

259:t_1:102.en:
$$くらら$$
「But just as friendship can cross the stars, I think love can bridge the gap between humans and androids.」

259:t_1:103.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Are you sure, $$くらら$$? If $$ＡＧ$$ hears that, he'll happily propose to you.」

259:t_1:105.en:
$$タケル$$
「Let's leave the jokes there and get ready for the hyperspace jump.」

259:t_1:106.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You're right. We have all sorts of preparations to make.」

259:t_1:108.en:
$$くらら$$
「You mean sidling up to us, $$ニコラ$$?」

259:t_1:109.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ノリコ$$ told me clothes turn transparent during a hyperspace jump.」

259:t_1:110.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Dimensional-wave whatever... Warp for short. It comes with a perk that good!?」

259:t_1:112.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「You're an enemy of women!」

259:t_1:113.en:
$$朔哉$$
「W-wait! Shouldn't you be mad at $$ニコラ$$!?」

259:t_1:114.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Of course, I said that knowing it was some sort of joke.」

259:t_1:115.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's right. $$ニコラ$$ would never do anything so indecent.」

259:t_1:116.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're the one who needs to reflect on your behavior, $$朔哉$$!」

259:t_1:118.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Sorry, $$朔哉$$. I was talking about an anime I watched.」

259:t_1:121.en:
$$朔哉$$
「They treat us so differently... What am I even here for...?」

259:t_2:3.en: ～$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$　Command Room～

259:t_2:6.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「We've moved about 230 light-years back toward the galactic center from where we encountered the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

259:t_2:8.en:
$$田中司令$$
「What shall we do? Should we tell everyone?」

259:t_2:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「There's no point hiding it. If this breaks their spirits, that's as far as they were ever going to go.」

259:t_2:10.en:
$$田中司令$$
「In other words, you trust that it won't?」

259:t_2:12.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I understand. I'll tell them at dinner, then.」

259:t_2:17.en:
$$恵子$$
「I never imagined this would happen...」

259:t_2:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, $$ワッ太$$! Is that god $$ゼウス$$ really on our side!?」

259:t_2:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「There's no doubt about it! We fought together during the $$時獄戦役$$!」

259:t_2:21.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...When $$ゼウス$$'s power transported us, did you hear something like a human voice?」

259:t_2:22.en:
$$さやか$$
「I did! It sounded like screaming, or crying...」

259:t_2:24.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「I-I don't really know, but it felt kind of good...」

259:t_2:25.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「Y-yeah! It sounds weird at a time like this, but it sort of calmed me down...!」

259:t_2:29.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But something powerful enough to interfere with a god like $$ゼウス$$...」

259:t_2:31.en:
$$勝平$$
「...Hey... What is a god, anyway?」

259:t_2:32.en:
$$勝平$$
「Those $$ミケーネ$$ guys and $$ゼウス$$ are a bit different from what I think of as gods...」

259:t_2:33.en:
$$恵子$$
「They are. The $$ミケーネ$$ gods in particular seemed to want to destroy humans instead of helping them.」

259:t_2:34.en:
$$さやか$$
「You and $$恵子$$ are right to wonder, $$勝平$$. We wondered the same thing during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

259:t_2:35.en:
$$タケル$$
「...This is just my opinion, but I think by 'gods,' they mean beings with power beyond humans.」

259:t_2:36.en:
$$タケル$$
「Our ideas of good and evil have nothing to do with it. Those with power simply call themselves gods.」

259:t_2:37.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「But, $$タケル$$... I can see it with $$ゼウス$$, but those $$ミケーネ$$ gods are more like demons.」

259:t_2:38.en:
$$タケル$$
「The $$ミケーネ$$ gods said they were gods, and that $$バアル$$ were the demons.」

259:t_2:39.en:
$$甲児$$
「They also said gods and demons were fighting in space, and human existence meant nothing.」

259:t_2:41.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「...Maybe so... If it'll take us years just to get home, we must look tiny to them and the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

259:t_2:42.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up, $$宇宙太$$! We didn't lose to the $$宇宙怪獣$$ or $$ミケーネ$$!」

259:t_2:43.en:
$$恵子$$
「We won today with $$ゼウス$$'s help... But we don't know what tomorrow will bring...」

259:t_2:44.en:
$$さやか$$
「We're closer to the galactic center now... If the $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest there, as they did in $$ノリコ$$'s world...」
